s1.syndrome_frame: A slowly growing vascular tumor on the scalp
salient_findings: 8-mm red, firm, mobile nodule on the left temporal scalp
Irregular red lacunae with irregular vessels and absence of septa on dermoscopic evaluation
Well-circumscribed dermal vascular tumor with ectatic thin-walled vessels and intravascular branching papillary structures on histopathology
key_facts: The patient is a man in his 40s
The patient has no significant medical history
The tumor is located on the left temporal scalp
The tumor is 8-mm in size
The tumor is red, firm, and mobile
Dermoscopic evaluation shows irregular red lacunae without septa and irregular linear vessels
Histopathology shows a well-circumscribed dermal vascular tumor
The tumor extends to the superficial subcutaneous tissue
The tumor is composed of ectatic thin-walled vessels with multiple intravascular branching papillary structures
The structures are covered by swollen endothelial cells with numerous intracytoplasmic eosinophilic hyaline globules
PAS staining shows positive hyaline globules in the cytoplasm of endothelial cells
Tumor vessels are positive for CD-31 and negative for D2-40 and HHV-8

shortlist.label: Glomeruloid hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Matches dermoscopic and histopathological findings of irregular red lacunae and ectatic thin-walled vessels with intravascular branching papillary structures

shortlist.label: Papillary intralymphatic angioendothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Consistent with dermoscopic evaluation showing irregular red lacunae and histopathological findings of papillary structures

shortlist.label: Retiform hemangioendothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Matches histopathological findings of well-circumscribed dermal vascular tumor with ectatic thin-walled vessels

shortlist.label: Dabska tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Consistent with histopathological findings of intravascular branching papillary structures and positive hyaline globules

shortlist.label: Epithelioid hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Matches histopathological findings of well-circumscribed dermal vascular tumor with swollen endothelial cells

shortlist.label: Spindle cell hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Consistent with histopathological findings of ectatic thin-walled vessels and intravascular branching papillary structures

shortlist.label: Hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Broad category that includes the patient's tumor, although less specific than other options

shortlist.label: Microvenular hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Matches histopathological findings of small, thin-walled vessels and dermoscopic evaluation of irregular red lacunae

raw.rationale: The presence of intracytoplasmic hyaline globules in endothelial cells, as shown by PAS staining, and the tumor's composition of ectatic thin-walled vessels with intravascular branching papillary structures, are characteristic features of Dabska tumor.

rejected.label: Papillary intralymphatic angioendothelioma
rejected.why: Tumor vessels are positive for CD-31 and negative for D2-40, which does not support a lymphatic origin

rejected.label: Retiform hemangioendothelioma
rejected.why: The tumor's architecture does not resemble a retiform pattern

rejected.label: Epithelioid hemangioma
rejected.why: The tumor's composition does not show epithelioid features

rejected.label: Spindle cell hemangioma
rejected.why: The tumor is composed of ectatic thin-walled vessels, not spindle cells

rejected.label: Hemangioma
rejected.why: The tumor's features are more specific and complex than a typical hemangioma

rejected.label: Microvenular hemangioma
rejected.why: The tumor's vessels are not microvenular in size or appearance
